mechanism: Scopolamine's anticholinergic effects may reduce gastric motility and alter tacrolimus absorption, while both agents can cause CNS depression and tacrolimus may increase anticholinergic side effects through additive mechanisms.
action: Monitor tacrolimus levels closely if scopolamine is initiated or discontinued; consider alternative antiemetic/antispasmodic agents; assess for signs of tacrolimus toxicity and anticholinergic effects.
